Subject: Review of English 30-1 academic honesty concern – Owen Kalinowski

Dear [Principal's name],

I'm writing to inform you of an academic honesty concern about Owen Kalinowski's English 30-1 critical essay on Hamlet, and to ask for your guidance before the matter goes further.

The essay was due on Thursday, October 29. The school's detection software flagged it, and I entered a mark of zero on Tuesday, November 3. I acknowledge that I entered the mark before contacting Owen's parent, which did not follow section 4.2 of our Academic Honesty Procedure. Owen learned of the mark through the online gradebook during class. I regret that.

I met with Owen's mother, Meredith Kalinowski, on Tuesday, November 10. She objects to the zero and to the process. She has said she intends to request your review under section 4.6. She has also pointed out that, under section 4.3, a detection result alone does not establish a concern.

Beyond the software result, the evidence I am relying on is: [list specific, dated items tied to Owen's own work, for example version history, drafts, or comparison with other samples of his writing].

As this appears to be a first concern, I propose the following, in line with section 4.4:
- The zero is withdrawn pending reassessment.
- Owen completes a private, supervised reassessment of the same outcomes.
- If the reassessment shows the learning, its mark replaces the original and nothing is placed in his student record.

I would welcome your direction, and I'm happy to meet with you and Ms. Kalinowski.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
English 30-1, Elbow Crossing High School

---
